column1: # ASCO 7000 Series Group 5 transfer switch controller (Modbus RTU) Modbus register map - easymodbus.com - source: https://ccontrols.com/support/dp/Asco%207000%20Group%205.pdf

column6: PHASE_0 - phase shift normal vs emergency

column15: bit 0 = Main on normal; bit 1 = Main on emergency; bit 2 = Auxiliary on normal; bit 3 = Auxiliary on emergency; bit 4 = Normal source available; bit 5 = Emergency source available
bit 0 = Normal rotation ABC; bit 1 = Normal rotation CBA; bit 2 = Emergency rotation ABC; bit 3 = Emergency rotation CBA; bit 4 = Engine exerciser with load active; bit 6 = External F17 active

column7: Bits 3-4 = switch type: 0 OTTS, 1 DTTS, 2 CTTS, 3 OTTS.
column15: bit 0 = Nominal 60 Hz (else 50 Hz); bit 1 = Normal 3-phase sensing; bit 2 = Emergency 3-phase sensing; bit 3 = Switch type bit 0; bit 4 = Switch type bit 1; bit 5 = Bypass switch; bit 6 = Dual breaker (else transfer switch), FW 607540-033

column6: TSAmp - transfer switch amp rating code

column15: bit 0 = Transfer switch locked out; bit 1 = CTTS extended parallel alarm; bit 2 = CTTS failure to synch alarm; bit 3 = DTTS load disconnect; bit 4 = External parameter lock active; bit 5 = Engine running; bit 6 = Normal breaker tripped (FW 607540-033); bit 7 = Emergency breaker tripped (FW 607540-033)

column7: Transfer sequence state; N/E = switch position.
column15: 0 = N: load on normal, normal OK; 1 = N: timer 1C (TDES) running; 2 = N: waiting for emergency acceptable; 3 = N: transfer to E inhibited by F6Z; 4 = N: transfer to E inhibited by F34B; 5 = N: timer 2B (TDNE) running; 6 = N: timer 31F (pre-transfer N>E) running; 7 = N: in-phase monitor delay (OTTS N>E); 8 = N: waiting for in-phase (OTTS N>E); 9 = N: in-phase delay with load shed (OTTS N>E); 10 = N: waiting for in-phase with load shed (OTTS N>E); 11 = N: in-sync delay (CTTS N>E); 12 = N: waiting for in-sync (CTTS N>E); 13 = N: sources paralleled (CTTS N>E); 14 = N: load disconnected CT bypass (CTTS N>E); 15 = N: load disconnected (DTTS N>E); 16 = E: N>E load shed active; 17 = E: timer 31M (post-transfer N>E) running; 18 = E: load on emergency, waiting for transfer requests to clear; 19 = E: timer 3A (TDEN) running; 20 = E: transfer to N inhibited by G6C; 21 = E: transfer to N inhibited by F34A; 22 = E: timer 31G (pre-transfer E>N) running; 23 = E: in-phase delay (OTTS E>N); 24 = E: waiting for in-phase (OTTS E>N); 25 = E: in-phase delay with load shed (OTTS E>N); 26 = E: waiting for in-phase with load shed (OTTS E>N); 27 = E: in-sync delay (CTTS E>N); 28 = E: waiting for in-sync (CTTS E>N); 29 = E: sources paralleled (CTTS E>N); 30 = E: load disconnected CT bypass (CTTS E>N); 31 = E: load disconnected (DTTS); 32 = N: E>N load shed active; 33 = N: timer 31N (post-transfer E>N) running; 34 = N: timer 2E (TDEC) running; 35 = N: timer 1C while timer 2E running; 36 = Power-up inhibit; 255 = Transition state (keep last state)

column7: Seconds or minutes left, or phase difference x 10, depending on state.

column15: bit 0 = Feature 6B; bit 1 = Feature 6C; bit 2 = Feature 17; bit 4 = Feature 29; bit 5 = Feature 30; bit 6 = Feature 34A; bit 7 = Feature 34B
bit 0 = Feature 89; bit 1 = CT bypass; bit 2 = Alarm reset; bit 3 = Feature 6D; bit 4 = Feature 5; bit 5 = Feature 6Z; bit 6 = Feature 34T

column7: Write 0-99 to select an event log entry.

column15: 1 = Engine start; 2 = Transfer N>E; 3 = Transfer E>N; 4 = Engine stop; 5 = Emergency acceptable; 6 = Emergency not acceptable; 7 = Normal acceptable; 8 = Normal not acceptable; 9 = Transfer abort; 10 = Breaker trip; 11 = YY primary fail

1 = Load shed; 2 = Normal fail; 3 = Manual transfer; 4 = Test 5; 5 = Test 17; 6 = Communication; 7 = Engine exerciser; 8 = Emergency fail; 9 = Normal under voltage; 10 = Normal over voltage; 11 = Normal under frequency; 12 = Normal over frequency; 13 = Normal phase rotation; 14 = Normal voltage unbalance; 15 = Emergency under voltage; 16 = Emergency over voltage; 17 = Emergency under frequency; 18 = Emergency over frequency; 19 = Emergency phase rotation; 20 = Emergency voltage unbalance; 21 = Feature 6; 22 = Normal breaker; 23 = Emergency breaker

column6: LogEntNr - number of event log entries

column7: Bits 0-5 mode (0 none, 1 islanding, 2 parallel base load, 3 import/export); bit 6/7 N/E breaker open.
